decisions.rationale: Several large bright-roofed rectangles appear near the center while adjacent bare plots and dark fields change extent.
Multiple long bright roofs replace a broad pale disturbed area in the central parcel despite a small masked patch.
Most of the frame is masked, and the remaining fragments mainly show color and atmospheric differences without a stable footprint comparison.
Within the surviving center-left fragments, exposed pale ground is replaced by aligned bright rectangular roofs, although much of the frame is masked.
Large masks leave only fragments, where roof brightness and exposed-ground differences do not resolve into a definite new footprint.
A broad dark undeveloped area becomes a dense group of large roofs, paved surfaces, and internal roads.
Numerous large rectangular roofs, cleared surfaces, and internal lanes appear across previously open terrain.
A small central compound expands northward into a much larger pale rectangular footprint with additional roofs and cleared ground.
Large dark rectilinear arrays appear immediately north of the central built area where green fields were visible before.
Scattered tonal and ground-surface differences occur across the frame, but no discrete new footprint is visually decisive.
Below the masked upper center, multiple long rectangular roofs and paved areas appear over previously open ground.
Field colors and vegetation tones vary, while roads and visible building footprints remain materially unchanged.
Extensive masks and clouds break up the urban view, leaving highlighted differences too fragmented to verify as footprint change.
Several very large bright-roofed rectangles and adjoining paved areas appear across the central and lower-left parcels despite scattered masking.
A previously open brown tract is occupied by a large bounded area of pale surfaces, dark roof-like rectangles, and internal lanes.
An extensive group of large rectangular roofs and broad reddish cleared surfaces replaces mostly dark open land.
Visible roads, small structures, and landforms retain the same geometry, with differences limited chiefly to overall color and vegetation tone.
Masks and cloud bands obscure parts of the scene, while apparent roof-brightness changes occur on largely pre-existing shapes.
New rectangular roofs, paved blocks, and a large pale cleared parcel appear across the upper half of the built area.
Several long bright roofs and darker roof blocks appear within the central pale footprint where mostly exposed ground was visible before.
A large bright irregular cleared and roofed area appears at the lower right where dark wooded ground was previously visible.
A broad grid of pale cleared surfaces, roofs, ponds, and internal roads replaces fields across the center.
Multiple large pale and reddish rectangular compounds, roofs, and gridded surfaces appear around the small original center.
Within the clear center, a lower compound gains several large bright roofs over previously pale exposed ground despite edge masking.
A large bright rectangular footprint with adjoining cleared surfaces appears east of the diagonal highway where fields were visible before.
A broad cluster of large rectangular roofs and reddish cleared surfaces replaces mostly dark open land.
A large bright irregular cleared and roofed area appears at the lower right where dark wooded ground was previously visible.
Clouds obscure the lower-left quarter, and highlighted roof-tone differences elsewhere do not show a decisive new footprint.
Several large bright roofs and looping internal roads appear across the upper central cleared tract despite the missing right-side coverage.
Heavy masking and cloud contamination leave disconnected fragments whose roof and ground differences cannot be verified as coherent change.
The visible street grid and building footprints are essentially unchanged, with only small scattered tonal differences and masked edges.
Most of the frame is masked, and a bright change in one surviving fragment lacks enough surrounding context to confirm a footprint.
Large new roofed and pale cleared footprints appear in the upper-left, center, and lower-right portions of the frame.
Haze and a masked patch reduce comparability, while the strong brightness change at the upper right could reflect surface or acquisition differences.
